title: India Tourist Visa — e-Visa
text: India offers e-Tourist Visa for citizens of eligible countries. Apply at least 4 days before travel. Valid for 30 days, 1 year, or 5 years depending on category. Required documents include passport with 6 months validity, recent photograph, and return ticket. e-Visa allows entry through designated airports and seaports. Processing typically takes 72 hours.
